rationale: The description meaningfully specifies conventional customer communication management, content and data reuse, personalization, and digital or print delivery. Personalization and real-time communications are not identified as AI functionality.
evidence_spans: designed for omnichannel customer communication management (CCM)
deliver communications through customers' preferred digital and print channels
conflict_response: Both proposals selected supported non-AI, while the parent concern questioned whether personalization, insight, and real-time delivery imply AI. The description directly states CCM, use of organizational data/content, and channel delivery but gives no AI-specific mechanism; the generic marketing language does not change the supported conventional judgment.
